Animal · 1 hex · SM +0 Porpoise [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: mundane birds, fish and aquatic animals; answers Porpoise (SRD 3.5)]

Bright, sociable and genuinely curious about boats, travelling in pods that will escort a hull for miles. Sailors count them lucky and are not entirely wrong: a pod harrying a shark has saved swimmers, and their squealing carries far enough underwater to be a warning if anyone can read it.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/porpoise.gct
  • Independent build total: 46 points of racial traits plus 6 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Porpoise (SRD 3.5). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 70 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 6; water Move 6, 12 at a sprint (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • About 1.8 m, which is the SM 0 row.
  • IQ 6 is deliberate and the highest in this batch: a porpoise is genuinely clever, and Will follows from it.
  • DR 1 is blubber rather than hide, which is why it is Tough Skin.
